title: A subterrain's doodads (map/terrain/<folder>/doodads.json)
description: The doodads and special doodads of war3map.doo.json whose position lies in this subterrain, read and written by crates/w3proj/src/terrain_objects.rs (docs/terrain-subterrains-spec.md, section 4). An entry is the flat file's entry (doodads.schema.json) with an optional `order` first. The file's version lives in terrain.json's dooHeader, so the keys a version needs aren't checked here. Other keys at the top are errors there, so they are refused here too.

order.description: its index in the flat file, where that isn't its place in this file's sorted order
